title: Kicked German Potato Pasta
description: A nutty and creamy German dish featuring green salsa and spherified elements, designed to be anti-inflammatory friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Germany with a unique twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the potatoes until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the green salsa to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with a small amount of water to create a spherification bath.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the potato mixture into the spherification bath.
Let the spherified potatoes sit for a few minutes to set.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, spherified potatoes, and parsley.
Toss everything together and top with feta cheese if desired.
